strategy_roster.name: Hans123 Trader v2
strategy_roster.notes: The documented buy-stop above the BreakoutPeriod=80 high is expressed as a prior-bar range breakout; the sell-stop side is dropped for a long-only test. Session StartHour/EndHour gating, pip stop/target, trailing step and the pending-order cap are not DSL constructs.

strategy_roster.name: XMACD Modes
strategy_roster.notes: Mode=MacdDisposition is the documented default, so the entry is the MACD(12/26) main line crossing its signal(9) line and the inverse cross exits. The other three modes (zero-line breakdown, MACD twist, signal twist) are not the default and are not encoded; StopLossPercent=2m and TakeProfitPercent=4m are used as percentages.

strategy_roster.name: MACD Volume Cluster
strategy_roster.notes: FastMacdPeriod 12 / SlowMacdPeriod 26 / MacdSignalPeriod 9 and VolumePeriod=20 with VolumeDeviationFactor=2.0 are documented, and volume_ratio(volume,20) is volume over its 20-bar average. The entry criteria are only referenced as 'see implementation', so the volume gate stands in for that cluster, and ATR-multiple stops are not percentages.

strategy_roster.name: Anchored Momentum Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: The documented EMA/SMA momentum ratio is written literally, entering while the ratio is above one and rising and exiting when it turns down. SmaPeriod/EmaPeriod are names only, so 9/21 are chosen fallbacks; StopLossPercent/TakeProfitPercent have no values, so both are null.

strategy_roster.name: Dskyz (DAFE) Adaptive Regime - Quant Machine Pro
strategy_roster.entry_long: adx(high,low,close,14) > 25 and close > bb_mid(close,20) and close > open
strategy_roster.notes: Regime classification with ATR, moving averages, Bollinger Bands and ADX becomes a trending-regime gate (ADX above 25, price above the Bollinger middle) plus a bullish candle at support. All thresholds are explicit fallbacks because the docs list no numeric values, and the short/candlestick-pattern side is dropped.

strategy_roster.name: Swaper Strategy (API 3751)
strategy_roster.notes: The EA rebuilds a virtual swap balance and rebalances a synthetic long/short portfolio against a fair-value equation with margin-based lot reduction, so it is a multi-leg money-flow engine with no single-symbol entry signal. The never-true guard prevents fabricating one.

strategy_roster.name: MasterMind 3
strategy_roster.entry_long: close <= donchian_low(low,26) and close <= donchian_low(low,27) and close <= donchian_low(low,29) and close <= donchian_low(low,30)
strategy_roster.notes: Williams %R is not whitelisted, so the documented -99.99 extreme for all four periods (26/27/29/30) is expressed as a close at or below each period's lowest low. The exit is mean reversion back to the 20-bar middle; the docs explicitly include no stops and reverse on the opposite signal.

strategy_roster.name: Earnings, Splits, Dividends
strategy_roster.notes: The docs state entry criteria none and long/short no trading: it only logs corporate-action news feed items. There is no market-derived signal to translate, so the never-true guard is used.

strategy_roster.name: Advanced Multi-Seasonality
strategy_roster.notes: Entries come from up to four preconfigured calendar dates and exits from a holding-day counter, with no indicators, so the signal is purely calendar-based. The DSL has no date or bar-count field, so the never-true guard is used instead of inventing one.

strategy_roster.name: Autostop
strategy_roster.notes: This is a position-management utility that attaches TakeProfitTicks=30 and StopLossTicks=30 to externally opened positions and generates no signals of its own. The never-true guard is used; tick offsets are not percentage fields.
